subject: Launch Week: Owner orientation, OKR slate & QBR prep
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Anita Gomez <anita.gomez@acmeinc.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launch Week: Owner orientation, OKR slate & QBR prep

Team —

Thanks for jumping into Launch Week. We have a tight window to lock OKR owners, finalize the slate, and assemble a QBR packet that will travel with the exec readout next month. High-level asks below so we can close by EOD Friday: 

1) Owners & commit: confirm the owner for each objective on the attached OKR input sheet. If you don’t own an objective, please nominate a primary + backup.

2) Metrics & rubrics: aditya — please upload the preferred measurement rubrics (unit definitions and gating thresholds) to the Drive link in this thread. We’ll bake those directly into the QBR deck.

3) QBR packet: I attached the QBR template (v1) — fill the one-slide per objective section with current metrics, progress commentary (2 bullets), and one ask for leadership.

4) Rollout plan: marcus — please confirm if we can commit to a canary rollout for the new routing changes in week 2 of the quarter; this affects capacity assumptions for the SLO owners.

Please reply with OWNER confirmations in-thread. If you need to loop in someone external for evidence or procurement, copy Anita — she’ll help with vendor intake and procurement slots.

Attachments: [Attachment: QBR_template_v1.pptx (pptx)], [Attachment: OKR_input_sheet.csv (csv)]

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Director, Product Strategy
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Launch Week: Owner orientation, OKR slate & QBR prep

> Team —
> 
> Thanks for jumping into Launch Week. We have a tight window to lock OKR owners...

Thanks, Jasmine — I can own Objective 1 (Reduce avg inference latency by 15% across hosted tier). Quick question: for the QBR slide, do you want the pre/post optimization latency distribution (p50/p95) or a throughput-normalized latency metric? I can prepare both but want to be efficient with the deck space.

Also tagging a quick note: I’ll need the final model list to compute p95 baseline (I think runtime has changed for two of the curated models).

—Lauren

Head of Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference

Lauren — both metrics make sense; I’ll put a short rubric in the Drive that maps metric -> recommended visualization (histogram for distribution, line for trend).

I uploaded a metrics_rubric.md to the shared folder with suggested thresholds and the gating logic for p50/p95 and throughput-normalized measures. We should standardize on throughput-normalized p95 for cross-model comparisons, with p50/p95 shown where we have model-stable baselines. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2Bq-QBR-Launch-Week

Also: a quick FYI on measurement timing — the baseline snapshots we have are from the last weekly run (2025-05-22). If owners need a fresher window, ping infra early today.

Attachments: [Attachment: metrics_rubric.md (text)]

—Aditya
Aditya Rao

Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 06 Jun 2025 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch Week: Owner orientation, OKR slate & QBR prep

Thanks — quick status and commitments from infra/engineering side: 

• Canary rollout: confirmed for week 2. We’ll reserve a 10% capacity pool for the canary; if we see regressions we’ll auto-fallback to previous routing.
• Owners: confirmed owners for objectives below (I validated with the teams):
  - Objective 1 (Latency): lauren_bishop (primary) / karthik_iyer (backup)
  - Objective 2 (Cost per token): aditya_rao (primary) / marcus_lin (backup)
  - Objective 3 (Reliability/SLO): marcus_lin (primary) / lauren_bishop (backup)

• Deliverables: owners please drop your one-slide updates into QBR_template_v1.pptx by EOD Friday, 2025-06-06. Aditya — I’ll use metrics_rubric.md to generate the p95 normalization script; please verify the thresholds before I run.

Forwarding to Anita for procurement follow-up on the extra GPU burst capacity we reserved (Anita — can you confirm slot and lead time?).

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
VP, Infrastructure & Runtime
Redwood Inference
